wear thin: He has used the same joke at every party, and now it is starting to wear thin with his friends.
他每次派對都講同一個笑話，現在朋友們已經開始覺得沒趣，失去效果了。
wear many hats: In a small company, workers often wear many hats, acting as salespeople, designers, and customer service staff.
在小公司裡，員工常常身兼數職，同時擔任業務、設計師和客服人員。
wear off: The medicine made me sleepy, but the effect began to wear off after about three hours.
這藥讓我想睡，但大約三小時後藥效開始逐漸消退。
wear down resistance: The salesman kept calling every day, hoping to wear down resistance from customers who did not want to buy.
這名推銷員每天不停打電話，希望磨掉那些不想購買的顧客的抵抗心理。
wear one's heart on one's sleeve: Mary wears her heart on her sleeve, so everyone can tell immediately when she is happy or upset.
瑪莉的感情很外露，所以她開心或難過時，大家馬上就看得出來。
wear out one's welcome: We stayed at my aunt's house for only three days because we did not want to wear out our welcome.
我們只在阿姨家住了三天，因為不想賴太久惹人厭。
wear well: These leather shoes are expensive, but they wear well and still look new after five years.
這雙皮鞋很貴，但很耐穿，五年後看起來仍然像新的一樣。
weather a crisis: The small restaurant managed to weather a crisis during the pandemic by selling food boxes online.
這間小餐廳在疫情期間靠著網路販售餐盒，成功挺過了危機。
weather criticism: The young mayor had to weather criticism from the public after the new bus routes caused traffic jams.
新公車路線造成塞車後，這位年輕市長必須承受來自民眾的批評。
weather the recession: Many families cut their spending on travel and eating out in order to weather the recession.
許多家庭減少旅遊和外食的花費，以熬過經濟衰退。
under the weather: I felt a bit under the weather this morning, so I stayed in bed and drank a lot of warm water.
我今天早上覺得身體有點不適，所以待在床上並喝了很多溫水。
weathered rock: Along the northern coast, you can see strange shapes of weathered rock formed by wind and waves over centuries.
沿著北海岸，你可以看到幾百年來被風和海浪塑造而成、形狀奇特的風化岩石。
weave a story: The writer can weave a story around a simple object, such as an old key found in a drawer.
這位作家能圍繞一個簡單的物品編織故事，例如在抽屜裡找到的一把舊鑰匙。
weave through traffic: Delivery riders often weave through traffic on their scooters, which can be very dangerous during rush hour.
外送員常騎著機車在車陣中穿梭，這在尖峰時段可能非常危險。
weave together: The movie weaves together the lives of three strangers who meet by chance in a Taipei night market.
這部電影將三個在台北夜市偶然相遇的陌生人的人生交織在一起。
weave a web of lies: To hide his gambling problem, the man began to weave a web of lies that fooled even his own wife.
為了隱藏他的賭博問題，這名男子開始編織謊言，連他的妻子都被騙了。
weave magic: When the old storyteller starts to speak, he seems to weave magic, and the children forget everything else.
當這位老說書人開始說話時，他彷彿施展了魔力，讓孩子們忘了其他一切。
weave cloth: In the past, women in this mountain village used wooden looms to weave cloth from cotton and hemp.
過去，這個山村的婦女用木製織布機以棉和麻來織布。
wed tradition with modernity: The new museum's design tries to wed tradition with modernity, mixing old temple roofs with glass walls.
這座新博物館的設計試圖融合傳統與現代，把古老的廟宇屋頂和玻璃牆結合在一起。
get wed: After dating for seven years, my cousin and her boyfriend finally decided to get wed next spring.
交往七年後，我表姊和她男友終於決定明年春天結婚。
wed in June: Many couples choose to wed in June because the weather is pleasant and it is a popular wedding season.
許多情侶選擇在六月成婚，因為天氣宜人，而且這是熱門的婚禮季節。
weed out the weak: The first week of training is very hard because the coaches want to weed out the weak players early.
訓練的第一週非常辛苦，因為教練們想及早淘汰較弱的球員。
weed out errors: Before you hand in your report, read it again carefully to weed out errors in spelling and grammar.
在交報告之前，再仔細讀一遍，把拼字和文法的錯誤剔除掉。
weed the garden: Every Saturday morning, my grandfather goes outside to weed the garden so the vegetables can grow well.
每週六早上，爺爺都會到外面為菜園除草，讓蔬菜長得好。
weed out bad candidates: The company uses an online test to weed out bad candidates before inviting people to job interviews.
這家公司在邀請人來面試之前，會用線上測驗篩掉不佳的人選。
weigh the options: Before choosing a university, you should weigh the options carefully, such as cost, location, and programs.
選擇大學之前，你應該仔細權衡各個選項，例如花費、地點和科系。
weigh the pros and cons: My parents need to weigh the pros and cons of moving to a bigger apartment farther from the city.
我爸媽需要權衡搬到離市區更遠、更大的公寓的利弊。
weigh on one's mind: The argument with his best friend weighed on his mind all day, and he could not focus in class.
和最好朋友的爭吵一整天都壓在他心頭，讓他上課無法專心。
weigh in on: Several famous scientists will weigh in on the debate about whether the new power plant is safe.
幾位知名科學家將針對新電廠是否安全的爭論發表意見。
weigh one's words: When you talk to someone who has just lost a family member, you should weigh your words carefully.
當你和剛失去家人的人說話時，應該仔細斟酌用詞。
weigh heavily: When choosing a new phone, battery life and price weigh heavily in most students' final decision.
在選擇新手機時，電池續航力和價格對大多數學生的最終決定影響重大。
weigh up a situation: A good firefighter must quickly weigh up a situation before deciding how to enter a burning building.
一位好的消防員在決定如何進入燃燒中的建築物前，必須迅速評估局勢。
